title: Developing environmentally relevant micro- and nanoplastics to assess removal efficiencies in wastewater treatment processes
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,748-761
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00250D, Paper
Martín Benzo, María Eugenia Pérez Barthaburu, Andrés Pérez-Parada, Álvaro Olivera, Laura Fornaro
This study presents a simple, cost-effective method to produce environmentally relevant micro- and nanoplastics as model particles for testing removal efficiency in wastewater treatment plants.
